title: AMD demand and earnings momentum improve
text: AMD reported revenue growth and beat expectations as AI accelerator demand improved. Management also raised guidance, citing market share gains and resilient enterprise orders.

title: AAPL suppliers warn on softer demand
text: AAPL suppliers warned that weaker demand and margin pressure could continue into the next quarter. Analysts cited lowered guidance, delays, and valuation concerns.

title: MSFT publishes routine operations note
text: MSFT published a routine operational update describing office openings, conference schedules, and general product availability. The note did not include financial outlook details or management commentary.

title: NVDA demand strength offset by valuation concerns
text: NVDA shares advanced after strong data-center demand and revenue growth, but analysts also highlighted valuation concerns, supply constraints, and rate uncertainty. The article described upside from HBM adoption while noting limited conviction.

title: META ad checks lack strength
text: META ad checks were not strong and showed no revenue growth in several regions. The update remained cautious because demand trends were unclear.
